name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth

booster.name: Draft Booster
booster.description: 15 cards: 10 commons (a traditional foil of any rarity replaces a common in a third of the boosters), 3 uncommons, a rare (87.6%) or mythic rare (12.4%), and a land: a basic land or, in a third of the boosters, a full-art Middle-earth map land.

cards: Now for Wrath, Now for Ruin!
One Ring to Rule Them All

set.name: Set Booster
set.description: 12 cards: a basic land (traditional foil in a fifth of the boosters), 3 commons, 3 uncommons, a common or uncommon showcase or scene card, 2 wildcards of any rarity, a rare or mythic rare, and a traditional foil of any rarity; a quarter of the boosters add a card from The List.

collector.name: Collector Booster
collector.description: 15 cards, all special: 4 traditional foil commons (in about 0.7% of the boosters a Sol Ring replaces one), 2 traditional foil uncommons, a traditional foil full-art basic land, a traditional foil rare or mythic rare, an extended-art rare or mythic rare from the set and one from its commander decks, a showcase uncommon, a showcase rare or mythic rare, a borderless scene card, a traditional foil showcase or scene uncommon or common, and a traditional foil showcase rare or mythic rare (in 0.8% of the boosters a surge foil relic of the commander decks instead). The Sol Rings are the commander decks' printing (the special arts aren't in the card data), the serialized One Ring the set's serialized printing.
